---
title: "4_heart_rate_response"
format: html
---

We load the necessary libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)

stressEcho <- read_csv(here("data", "_raw", "stressEcho.csv"), na = c("N/A"))

head(stressEcho)
```

1. Prototype: maxhr vs age (+ line 220 - age)

```{r}
ggplot((data = stressEcho),
  mapping = aes(x = age, y = maxhr))+
  geom_abline(slope = -1, intercept = 220)+
  geom_point()
```

2. Summaries by gender, diabetes, hypertension

```{r}

stressEcho |> 
  group_by(gender) |> 
  summarise(n = n(),
            mean_maxhr = mean(maxhr, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_maxhr = sd(maxhr, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_pctMphr = mean(pctMphr, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_Mphr = sd(pctMphr, na.rm = TRUE))
           
```

3. Plot: maxhr vs age by gender, fitted lines
4. Linear regression: maxhr ~ age + gender + hxofDM
5. Target heart rate vs event rate
